realm_description: Not a fixed place, but what Maruto becomes when civilization falls out of balance. Harai is temporary by nature — when balance returns, it transforms back into Maruto, a cycle called The Great Turning.

primary.label: Pathfinder
primary.description: Pioneers toward new worlds; rejects comfort as a destination.
primary.guiding_promise: I reject comfort as a destination — the frontier is where I belong.
primary.shadow_description: Pushes so far past the frontier that no one is left who remembers why they went.

secondary.label: Guardian
secondary.description: Loyal and protective; loss of the people they shield is the deepest fear.
secondary.guiding_promise: I will shield what I love, even when it costs me everything.
secondary.shadow_description: Protects so completely that the people they love never learn to stand on their own.

wheel.central_question: Should we hold the center steady, or abandon it for the frontier?

growth.label: Guardian
growth.description: Loyal and protective; loss of the people they shield is the deepest fear.
growth.guiding_promise: I will shield what I love, even when it costs me everything.
growth.shadow_description: Protects so completely that the people they love never learn to stand on their own.

other_ally.label: Explorer
other_ally.description: Fears limitation more than the unknown; needs to discover.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I will go where no map exists and make my own path.
other_ally.shadow_description: Never stays anywhere long enough to build something that could have lasted.

quarter.label: Sage
quarter.description: Lets truth settle slowly; offers wisdom gently to those still searching.
quarter.guiding_promise: I will wait for the truth to settle, and share it without needing credit.
quarter.shadow_description: Waits so long for the truth to settle that it's no longer useful by the time they speak it.

opposite.label: Chancellor
opposite.description: The quiet spine behind institutions; translates vision into something that survives contact with reality.
opposite.guiding_promise: I will hold the center so the whole does not fall apart.
opposite.shadow_description: Mistakes holding the center for holding on too tightly, and resists any change the institution actually needs.

realmmate.label: Reformer
realmmate.description: Driven by justice, dreads stagnation more than backlash.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I will not accept a broken world when a better one is possible.
realmmate.shadow_description: Burns down what was merely imperfect, mistaking any resistance for the enemy.

wheel.compatible_text: Reformer · Warden — fellow travelers of The Broken Heart.
